_comment: Animated dialogue portraits (movement + lip-sync + blinking). Read by DialogueAvatar; nothing here is hard-coded in C++ (see DIALOGUE_AVATAR_LIPSYNC.md). Motion offsets are in reference pixels for a ~512 px avatar and divided by render.pixel_scale_divisor at draw time, so a larger divisor means calmer motion.

voice._comment: RMS envelope + mouth gating. rms_ceiling is the raw RMS that maps to a fully open mouth (aituber-onair uses 0.12); envelope_hz is the precomputed envelope's resolution.

blink._comment: Blinks: per_min > 0 drives a Poisson interval (OpenFaceFX ~15/min) and snaps onto pauses; otherwise the uniform interval_* window is used. hold_* is how long the eyes stay shut.

visemes._comment: Baked per-line mouth tracks (<wav>.visemes.json, baked by tools/gen_visemes.py). states maps the Hanna-Barbera letters A-H/X to the portrait's mouth shapes; a letter in none of the sets is closed. Missing/broken sidecar -> the loudness envelope is used instead.

idle._comment: Ambient breathing/roll that runs under every animated style. freq is Hz. Small on purpose - even a couple of pixels reads large on a full-height portrait.

puppet._comment: Gentle spring-wobble (the default). Keep this SUBTLE: phase_base/phase_voice set the bob speed (higher = nervous/fast), target_y_* set the height, max_rotation the tilt, energy_* how much voice drives it. Calmer = lower all of them. stiffness/damping only shape how it eases.

bounce._comment: Livelier jump/gravity motion (AvatarMotionStyle::Bounce). impulse_* are per loudness; gravity pulls the jump back down; impact_divisor turns landing speed into squash.

emphasis._comment: Emphasis nods: a quick downward dip on a rising loudness edge (stressed syllable), then a spring return. impulse = dip strength, threshold/rising_edge gate when it fires, max clamps it.

render._comment: Reference-pixel offsets are multiplied by (portrait height / pixel_scale_divisor). Raise it for calmer motion, lower it for bigger motion.
